svg.aria-label: How Token ACL thaws a holder's account. A new holder account opens frozen. Anyone can send a permissionless thaw to the Token ACL program, which asks the gate program; the Token ACL config authority can also freeze or thaw directly, swap the gate, or reclaim the freeze authority. The gate reads the list and approves the thaw only if the wallet qualifies; otherwise the account stays frozen and the transaction fails. In allowlist mode only listed wallets qualify; in blocklist mode every wallet qualifies except listed ones. An issuer can also write a custom gate. The list operator maintains the list, driven by offchain checks such as KYC and sanctions screening, and by attestations.
